Probably possible to be built as an add-on, but since it affects the global experience of different project and different users it would be the best to get the same behavior between projects. As mention by @[RobProductions](https://github.com/RobProductions) in [#8780](https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/8780) i also think this issue help to push a better add-on ecosystems similar what mentioned in [#1205](https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/1205).

Please let me now that this is helpful and can be done or there some other technical limitation that i not consider yet.
